description: Employee turnover rate and turnover cost from a business's own figures. Rate: people who left divided by average headcount times 100 (the Bureau of Labor Statistics separation-rate arithmetic), annualized for a period under 12 months, each step shown. An industry code adds the 2025 Bureau of Labor Statistics separations rate, published monthly; the yearly figure is 12 times it. Cost per departure adds only the lines sent (hiring, empty-seat days, ramp-up at a productivity gap that defaults to 50%, training hours, lost-knowledge hours); no percent-of-salary rule of thumb.

industry.description: Industry code, e.g. retail or health-care; a wrong code returns the list

separations.description: People who left in the period
